title: ContractVille
provenance: Reported by ObT1337 (highball#202, 2026-09-25), Apple M1, macOS 15.6.1, Highball 0.9.35, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r7, DXVK mode, launched as a pinned program with -dx11 from an external exFAT drive: the Unreal, GeForce NOW and publisher logos play, then a black screen. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Unreal Engine. Reported stuck on a black screen after the three startup logos. The launch log ends in Wine's media layer failing to decode a video (GStreamer 'gst_video_info_from_caps' assertions), so the lead is the game's next video hanging the way The Last Caretaker's menu video did; the reporter is trying Media Foundation switched off for the game. No frame rate, nothing measured here.

knownIssues.symptom: Black screen after the startup logos (reported on an M1, macOS 15.6.1, engine r7, DXVK mode, highball#202).
knownIssues.cause: lead, not confirmed: the game's next video does not decode in Wine's media layer, and the game waits on it.
knownIssues.fix: none confirmed. Being tried: Media Foundation off for the game's executable (mfplat DLL override), the fix that works for The Last Caretaker.
